description: Epicenter Home launches applications in the development build, on the explicitly selected loopback port (ADR-0189). Home is the only window that lists what a person can launch, so it is the only window that holds the verb. This is not the app-facing `openApp(appId)` of ADR-0181, which targets an admitted catalog member only; every other app reaches its own window through the tray, a deep link, or the host itself.
